decisions.reason: The supplement range sits within the firm's established consumer health offer and fits the stated strategy of broadening the portfolio, and nothing points to a shortfall against aspirations.
The skin and hair supplement is close to the core pharmacy business and cheap to carry, so an expanding firm with slack has little reason to start problemistic search over it.
As an extension of the Trivital brand, the joint supplement uses existing brand and distribution at low incremental cost, and no problem has been reported.

Although the 2018 valsartan recall hurt this distant, price-competitive generic, the firm kept it in 2019 and has had time to recover, and a blood pressure generic supports its prescription portfolio, so it stays for now while remaining at risk.
The OTC triptan is a recent, differentiated consumer health product that matches the strategy of expanding OTC offerings, and the missing archived pages say nothing about its performance.
